{{Top|leg}}
'''Crozwon''' was an individual who worked as a teacher at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] maneuver known as the [[Crozwon Catapult]] was named after Crozwon.
